title: Resolution urging Albany to pause new data center permits
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass, and the governor to sign, S.9144/A.10141, which would impose at least a three-year moratorium on permits for new data centers in New York. The bill would also require the Department of Environmental Conservation to study data centers' environmental impact and require the Public Service Commission to ensure data centers, not ratepayers, bear the added electricity and gas costs they cause. It cites concerns about strained power grids, pollution and rising utility rates in New York City.
